name: services/crstests/user_grades
description: Get grades which a token issuer got in nodes specified by node_ids parameter. Please see the note about automatic grading (algorithm note).
brief_description: Get student's grades for some nodes.

arguments.name: node_ids
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of node ids.
	All the node_ids supplied should belong to one test tree.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.
